test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Nandan had some marbles. When he distributed the marbles equally among 32 children, he found that 4 marbles were left. Had he distributed the marbles equally among 41 children and 48 children, he still would have had 13 and 20 marbles, respectively, left with him. But when he distributed them equally among 53 children, no marble was left. The number of marbles that Nandan initially had may lie between __________.
solution:
**Given:**

Nandan had some marbles.

When divided by 32, remainder = 4.

When divided by 41, remainder = 13.

When divided by 48, remainder = 20.

When divided by 53, remainder = 0.

**Formula used:**

Use congruences / CRT.

N ≡ 4 (mod 32), N ≡ 13 (mod 41), N ≡ 20 (mod 48), N ≡ 0 (mod 53).

Observe: 32 - 4 = 41 - 13 = 48 - 20 = 28 ⇒ N + 28 is multiple of 32, 41, 48.

So, N + 28 = LCM(32,41,48) × k.

**Calculations:**

32 = 2⁵

41 = 41¹

48 = 2⁴ × 3

⇒ LCM(32,41,48) = 2⁵ × 3 × 41 = 32 × 3 × 41 = 3936

⇒ N + 28 = 3936 × k

⇒ N = 3936 × k - 28

Also N is multiple of 53 ⇒ 3936 × k - 28 ≡ 0 (mod 53)

⇒ (3936 mod 53) × k ≡ 28 (mod 53)

3936 = 53 × 74 + 14 ⇒ 3936 ≡ 14 (mod 53)

⇒ 14k ≡ 28 (mod 53)

⇒ k ≡ 2 (mod 53) (divide both sides by 14)

Smallest k = 2

⇒ N = 3936 × 2 - 28

⇒ N = 7872 - 28 = 7844

Check:

⇒ 7844 ÷ 32 = 245 remainder 4

⇒ 7844 ÷ 41 = 191 remainder 13

⇒ 7844 ÷ 48 = 163 remainder 20

⇒ 7844 ÷ 53 = 148 remainder 0

**∴ N = 7844.**

**∴ 7844 lies between 7834 and 7854 **
